figures.finding: A resident pays no income tax on the first MAD 40,000 a year, then 10%, 20%, 30%, 34% to MAD 180,000 and 37% above; there is no regional income tax.

figures.finding: The tax year is the calendar year; a return, where required, is filed online before 1 March of the next year, and an independent professional files before 1 May, paying any tax with the return.

sources.said: Tax year: The tax year is the calendar year.

Filing and payment: Where an income tax return is required, it must be filed online before 1 March of the following year. Independent professionals must file before 1 May. Payment of any tax due must be made at the time of filing.

figures.finding: CNSS contributions on gross pay: the employee pays 4.48% social allocation (on pay up to MAD 6,000 a month) and 2.26% medical care; the employer pays 6.40% family allocation, 8.98% social allocation (to MAD 6,000), 1.60% training and 4.11% medical care.
figures.applies: 2026; self-employed (AMO for independents) terms not read.

figures.finding: Tax on pay is withheld by the resident employer; an employee with one Moroccan employer and only pay need not file.

sources.said: IIT on salaries is paid by way of withholdings made by resident employers. For individuals employed by one Moroccan resident entity and earning only employment

figures.finding: A non-resident is taxed only on Moroccan-source income; under the Code all payments for services by non-residents bear 10% withholding, though treaties confine it to royalties.
figures.applies: The artistes' fee rule (CGI art. 73-II-G) was not confirmed; see blocker.

sources.said: Individuals not having their tax residence in Morocco are subject to tax only on Moroccan-sourced income.

According to the Moroccan Tax Code, all payments of all kinds of services rendered by non-resident entities are subject to WHT at the rate of 10%. However, it shall be noted that treaty dispositions limit the scope of application of WHT only to remunerations that constitute royalties.

figures.finding: VAT is 20% (reduced 10%); an individual providing services is exempt while the year's turnover is 500,000 dirhams or less, and once liable may leave only after three years in a row at or below it.
figures.applies: 2026: CGI art. 91-II-3° (from loi de finances 50-22), read 2026-11-03.

sources.said: Rates: The standard rate of VAT is 20%, with a reduced rate of 10% applying to certain transactions.
Registration: To register for VAT purposes, all persons subject to VAT must make a “declaration of existence” within 30 days of

3°- Les ventes et prestations de services, effectuées par les fabricants et les prestataires, personnes physiques, dont le chiffre d'affaires annuel est inférieur ou égal à cinq cent mille (500.000) dirhams.

figures.finding: An artist's fee (cachet), paid to an artist working alone or in a troupe, bears withholding at 30% after a flat 50% allowance (15% of the gross); the withholding isn't final, so the artist's income is still reckoned in the year's return.
figures.applies: 2026: CGI arts. 60-II (the 50% allowance, from loi de finances 55-23), 73-II-G-4° (30%), and art. 73's last paragraph, whose list of final withholdings leaves G-4° out.
